description: exp-062's own headline numeric-proximity ratio (the black-matrix patent's alpha_true vs the corrected, transmission-based reading) is cited verbatim at six sibling sites across two experiments' own records plus LOGBOOK.md/PLAN.md/SESSION_LOG.md. A future edit to any one site (a rebase of the underlying OD figure, a re-derivation) that fails to update all six would be exactly the 'a NUMBER drifting unreconciled across sibling files' failure this entry exists to catch.

description: exp-062 Section 4.2 establishes that a REFLECTANCE-basis OD figure implies a round-trip through the layer, so the physically consistent single-pass alpha uses tau_R = OD*ln10/2 (halved), not the undivided tau = OD*ln10 used for transmission-basis figures. EM-6 (NiP-black) and EM-7 (carbon/graphene aerogel) both feed an R=<percent>-labeled figure into that same alpha calculation -- the SAME derivation methodology (OD-to-alpha conversion) applied to the SAME reflectance-basis condition Section 4.2 defines -- and both must disclose the reflectance basis and its halving treatment at the point the formula is actually applied, not only in a general methodology section elsewhere. Iteration 39 Phase-4 shipped both without the disclosure; caught independently by two blind Phase-5 reviews (PHOTONICS, ELECTROMAGNETISM), fixed same-shift (mandatory fix 5).
